messages.author: a8b6459b77c849fe
messages.subject: Confusing documentation for reshape2
parts:
As much as I appreciate these wonderful libraries Hadley Wickham has written, I find myself very frustrated with the documentation for reshape2. Is there any document for reshape2 that is comparable to the JSS article on its predecessor reshape (http://www.jstatsoft.org/v21/i12/paper)?

Also, does anyone know where to find some good, *thorough* documentation for acast and dcast? I have found the doc page that comes with the reshape2 package to be so perfunctory and ambiguous as to be nearly useless; furthermore, the description for the drop parameter is inconsistent with the results I get as I've experimented with acast.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Confusing documentation for reshape2
parts:
Without trying to be sarcastic, what types of non-perfunctory or
non-ambiguous applications did you have in mind? Reproducible examples
would be helpful. Both plyr and reshape2 could use a more expansive
set of documentation, but input from potential users like yourself who
find it frustrating would be helpful to inform certain directions one
could pursue.

Dennis
